preconditions.description: The number of intersections n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of roads m must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: All intersections connected by roads must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to create the routes, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by three valid routes.
Each route must have at least three intersections, including the start and finish.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(route.split()[1:])) == len(route.split()) - 1 for route in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each route must not visit the same intersection more than once, except for the start and finish.
